answer: Registration binds each identity to a 200-unit bond escrowed against a hardware credential and a proof-of-work token logged once per device in a single harbor ledger. Forging N fakes locks 200N units for 30 epochs and risks 100 percent slashing on detection. Copying identities raises marginal cost per fake, while jurors drawn from the stake spiral forfeit shared bonds and flag the lagoon of duplicate credentials.
